units.en: ⟦0⟧ or as known as ⟦1⟧ (⟦2⟧) is a minor nation in Africa. They start out as an ⟦3⟧ of ⟦4⟧. It has the releasables of ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧. It is bordered by ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧. Alternatively, when used with the Africa Decolonized rule (which can be found in the custom game rules), it is bordered by the ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧, ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, ⟦17⟧, ⟦18⟧ (across Lake Tanganyika), ⟦19⟧, ⟦20⟧, ⟦21⟧, the Cabinda exclave of Angola, and the South Atlantic Ocean. Most of it is dense jungle while the state of Leopoldville is mostly forest. Although not in a great position, it has the possibility to greatly expand.

The Belgian Congo was directly involved in the two world wars. During World War I (1914–1918), an initial stand-off between the Force Publique and the German colonial army in German East Africa turned into open warfare with a joint Anglo-Belgian-Portuguese invasion of German colonial territory in 1916 and 1917 during the East African campaign. The Force Publique gained a notable victory when it marched into Tabora in September 1916 under the command of General Charles Tombeur after heavy fighting.

During World War II, the Belgian Congo served as a crucial source of income for the Belgian government in exile in London after the occupation of Belgium by the Nazis. Following the occupation of Belgium by the Germans in May 1940, the Belgian Congo declared itself loyal to the Belgian government in exile in London. The Belgian Congo and the rest of the Free Belgian forces supported the war on the Allied side in the Battle of Britain with 28 pilots in the RAF (squadron 349) and in the Royal South African Air Force (350 Squadron) and in Africa. The Force Publique again participated in the Allied campaigns in Africa. Belgian Congolese forces (with Belgian officers) notably fought against the Italian colonial army in Italian East Africa, and were victorious in Asosa, Bortaï and in the Siege of Saïo under Major-general Auguste-Eduard Gilliaert during the second East African campaign of 1940–1941. On 3 July 1941, the Italian forces (under General Pietro Gazzera) surrendered when they were cut off by the Force Publique. A Congolese unit also served in the Far Eastern Theatre with the British army in the Burma campaign.
During the 1940s and 1950s, the Belgian Congo experienced extensive urbanisation and the colonial administration began various development programs aimed at making the territory into a "model colony"

⟦0⟧ gets a unique national focus tree as part of the ⟦1⟧ expansion. Without the expansion, The Belgian Congo becomes the Congolese state, is releasable and utilizes the ⟦2⟧.
The Belgian Congolese national focus tree can be divided into 9 branches, 8 sub-branches and 1 joint branch section:
The joint branch shared with ⟦0⟧. It mainly builds industry within the Congo region, builds up the Force Publique, and sets the future of the ⟦1⟧.
This decreases and removes the effects of the ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. It can only be done when the ⟦2⟧ is independent.
This pre-independence branch strengthens the colonial regime. It builds up the country's industry, develops certain states and decreases autonomy.
The Intore Lion Dancers/Formally Recognize the Kimbanguist Church Sub-branch
These shared focuses give units and a special advisor that increases autonomy and compliance.
Found the Congolese National Movement/National Committee for Liberation Branch

This pre-independence branch pushes the Belgian Congo to independence. The left side focuses on a more diplomatic independence, while focusing on increasing ⟦0⟧ popularity. The right side focuses on a more violent independence via civil war with mainly increasing ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ popularity and getting aid from either ⟦3⟧ or the ⟦4⟧
The Congo and the War in Europe Branch

If ⟦0⟧ ends up in a war and the Belgian Congo is its puppet, this branch becomes available. It gives resources to its allied nations like ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, gains supplies from the ⟦3⟧ and it may be able to gain independence with ⟦4⟧ backing.
Establish the Armée Nationale Congolaise Branch
The military branch modifies the ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ and builds up the navy, airforce and army.
This post-independence branch is available if the country has more than 40% ⟦0⟧ popularity. It lowers the effects of ⟦1⟧, and builds the country's industry. It grants claims to the Congo Basin.
This shared post-independence branch builds up industry, gains resources, and gives bonuses to infrastructure, and supply construction.

This post-independence branch is available if the country has more than 40% ⟦0⟧ popularity. It proclaims the ⟦1⟧. The left side, allies itself with the ⟦2⟧ and builds resistance in colonial territories in Africa. The right side, similar to the branch ⟦3⟧ tree, liberates and integrates African countries, and forms the ⟦4⟧.

If the Congo cannot form a government after independence with less than 40% of either party popularity, a regency council is formed in order to elect a monarch for the country. This will unlock one of six different sub-branches depending on the monarch chosen.
The House of Água Rosada Sub-branch

This installs Pedro VII and forms the ⟦0⟧. The newly reformed kingdom may force an independence war or a civil war in the south in order to annex a released ⟦1⟧ and core the neighboring states. The player may decide to become a Catholic kingdom for defensive and ⟦2⟧ bonuses and increased opinion with other Catholic dominated countries, or it could follow the Bundu dia Kongo religion and gain offensive and War support bonuses. It can also reform the royal council and gain military bonuses and War goal justification bonuses. It also has an extra lowering of the effects of ⟦3⟧.

This installs Mbóp Mábíínc maMbéky and forms the ⟦0⟧. It emphasizes the area's traditional culture and gives industry, construction, population and trade bonuses. It also decreases division attack and defense but increases organization.

This installs Moe Poaty III and forms the ⟦0⟧. The country may decide to give absolute power to the King, giving ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ or appointing a royal council, decreasing ⟦3⟧ in exchange for War support, more ⟦4⟧ and advisor cost reduction. It also gives ⟦5⟧ production and a bonus in factory output and breakthrough. For territorial expansion, it allows the annexation and coring of the historical territory of Loango: the ⟦6⟧ state of the Middle Congo and the ⟦7⟧ state of Cabinda. The country may also decide to ally with those countries.

This installs Mwambutsa IV Bangiricenge and forms the ⟦0⟧. If the state of Burundi was lost, the country can demand the state from its owner. The king can then gain War goal justification bonuses. Burundi may also claim, demand and core states from around the great lakes to rebuild the borders of the Empire of Kitara. It can then expand south to Malawi and Zabezia-Moçambique.

This installs Mutara III Rudahigwa and forms the ⟦0⟧. If the state of Rwanda was lost, the country can demand the state from its owner. Rwanda can then expand across the Lake Victoria strategic region and can either choose to develop its industry or build up its military. It can also form the ⟦1⟧.

This installs the pro-German former King of Rwanda Yuhi V Musinga and forms the ⟦0⟧. Unlike the other monarchist sub-branches, this may be done as a ⟦1⟧ nation as well as ⟦2⟧. It may then request to become a ⟦3⟧ protectorate if ⟦4⟧ is ⟦5⟧ or ⟦6⟧ ;or if ⟦7⟧ hasn't completed the focus ⟦8⟧, it may instead take German advisors. Afterwards, It may gain decisions to integrate states within the German planned Middle Africa and states within the same region. It will also gain War Goals against countries that owns those states except the ⟦9⟧ colonies.
